verdict.rationale: Cline's own docs say the agent can read the codebase and run searches in Plan mode. Its subagents explore the codebase independently and return detailed reports, so it gathers context itself rather than relying on manually selected files. Nothing documents a whole-codebase map or architectural overview, and a community comment notes Cline deliberately does not index the codebase, though that is design criticism rather than a concrete failure. Missing for 10: documented whole-repo mapping or indexing, explicit codebase-explanation workflow docs, hands-on corroboration of exploring large unfamiliar repos.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent map and explain an entire unfamiliar codebase without manually selecting context files

citations.quote: In this mode, Cline can read your codebase, run searches, and discuss strategy, but cannot modify any files or execute commands.
Each subagent gets its own prompt and context window, explores the codebase independently, and returns a detailed report to the main agent.
